name: Consistent-Carbohydrate (Diabetic) Hospital Diet
description: Illustrative consistent-carbohydrate policy. Verify thresholds against your institution's current diet manual.

rules.title: Main meals: 45-60 g carbohydrate
rules.source: Consistent-carbohydrate diet: 45-60 g/meal (common hospital standard; ADA supports consistent carb distribution)
rules.remedy: Adjust starch/fruit portions to land inside the range.

rules.title: Snacks: at most 30 g carbohydrate
rules.remedy: Reduce snack portion or pair a smaller carb portion with protein.

rules.title: No sugar-sweetened beverages or juice
rules.source: ADA Standards of Care: minimize sugar-sweetened beverages
rules.remedy: Serve water, unsweetened tea, or milk instead.

rules.title: Avoid desserts/sweets unless carb-counted by a dietitian
rules.source: Institutional practice: discretionary sweets need dietitian approval
rules.remedy: Replace with fruit or plain yogurt.

rules.title: Saturated fat <10% of daily calories
rules.source: Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020-2025: <10% kcal from saturated fat
rules.remedy: Replace cheese, bacon and fatty cuts with lean protein or plant oils.

rules.title: Fibre at least 14 g per 1,000 kcal
rules.source: Dietary Guidelines for Americans: 14 g fibre per 1,000 kcal
rules.remedy: Add whole grains, legumes, vegetables, or nuts.

rules.title: Daily energy between 1,500 and 2,200 kcal
rules.source: Typical adult inpatient energy range; individualise per dietitian
rules.remedy: Adjust portion sizes to the patient's prescribed energy level.
